subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】doing morning exercises 做早操; having ... class 上……课; eating lunch 吃午餐; reading a book 读书; listening to music 听音乐; keep 保持; turn 轮到; talk quietly 小声讲话; take turns 按顺序来
【重点句型】What are they doing? 他们在做什么？ They're ... 他们在…… Talk quietly. 小声说话。 Keep your desk clean. 保持桌面整洁。 Work quietly! 安静地工作！
【A Let's talk】Tom: Look! They're eating lunch. John: Shh. Talk quietly. Tom: OK. John: Keep your desk clean. Tom: OK, I will. John: Work quietly in the library.
【Read and write】It is 8:00 a.m. We are having English class. Some students are reading books. Some are listening to music. Some are drawing pictures. In the library, we talk quietly and keep the desk clean.
key_points: What are they doing? 他们在做什么？
Keep your desk clean. 保持桌面整洁。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
